description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Resource_File class, an internal plugin resource handler for Smarty templates that manages template files, including loading content, resolving file paths, and updating metadata. It is specifically tailored to work with Smarty's template resource system.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Resource_File
classes.description: Handles file system resource management for Smarty templates, including locating, reading, and validating template files.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the source object with metadata such as filepath, timestamp, and existence status based on the resource and security policies.

methods.name: populateTimestamp
methods.description: Updates the timestamp and existence status of the source object based on the current file state.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the template source file or throws an exception if unable to read.

methods.name: getBasename
methods.description: Returns the base filename of the resource's filepath.

methods.name: buildFilepath
methods.description: Constructs the absolute path to a template file by resolving relative and absolute paths, template directories, and including handling of special path syntax.
